title: Encrypted EFS File System
scenario: Create a shared file system with encryption at rest enabled.

focus.title: Complete the aws_efs_file_system resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_efs_file_system.

hints.why: Security settings are easiest to review when they are explicit in code. A default that looks harmless in a console can become a production finding.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_efs_file_system" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_efs_file_system. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Make security controls explicit whenever a resource exposes data, identity or network access.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_efs_file_system" "this"`. Use this code shape: creation_token; encrypted. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
